scripts.gen: npm run gen:migrations && npm run gen:migrations:post
scripts.gen:migrations:post: node -e "const fs = require('fs');const path = require('path');const dir = './internal/migrations/gen' || '.';fs.readdirSync(dir).forEach(file => {const newName = file.split('_')[0] + path.extname(file);if (newName !== file)fs.renameSync(path.join(dir, file), path.join(dir, newName));});"
